title: Spire and Sigil
author: Felix Nakamura
blurb: Silas Kavanagh, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
